newsitem.title: BRAZIL: OLYMPICS-RIO CHIEF CONFIDENT ON GAMES BID.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-RIO CHIEF CONFIDENT ON GAMES BID.

text.p: "Rio is favourite" declared the city's Olympic chief on Friday in response to the International Olympic Committee's (IOC) evaluation report of their bid for the 2004 Games.
"We are very satisfied with the report. We are very confident," said Ronaldo Cezar Coelho, president of Rio de Janeiro's Olympic committee.
"The report recognised very well all the positive points of our proposal. The report and our proposal are completely coherent.

Coelho shrugged off the city's weak points mentioned in the report, such as pollution and telecommunications and transport shortcomings, saying the whole aim of Rio's Olympic bid was to transform the city into a better place for its citizens.
"It (the Olympic bid) is a process of transformation which will be crowned in 2004," Coelho said. "Our proposal recognised the city's problems and it is precisely these we want to change."
He said funding for the city's ambitious infrastructure and environmental improvements was guaranteed.
